# Metro Appliance Services

> Locally owned appliance repair in Prince George's County, Maryland, and
> Washington, DC. Based in Largo, MD. In business since 2019. Owner and lead
> technician: Foman "Frank" Robinson.
> Not affiliated with Metro Appliance businesses in Iowa, Oklahoma or California.

## What we repair
- Refrigerators, washers, dryers, ranges and ovens, cooktops and stoves,
  dishwashers, garbage disposals
- Dryer vent cleaning
- Brands: Samsung, LG, GE, Whirlpool, Maytag, Frigidaire, Electrolux,
  KitchenAid, Kenmore, Jenn-Air, Bosch, Miele, Sub-Zero, Viking, Thermador

## Pricing
- Service call: $85, waived if you go ahead with the repair
- Typical repair ranges: refrigerator $150–$400, dryer $120–$350,
  oven/range $130–$400, cooktop $120–$350, garbage disposal $80–$200,
  dryer vent cleaning $99–$149
- Full price quoted before any work starts

## Warranty and parts
- 1-year limited warranty on parts and labor (exclusions in Terms)
- OEM or manufacturer-approved parts

## Where we work
Largo, Bowie, Mitchellville, Upper Marlboro, Clinton, Waldorf, Silver Spring,
Riverdale, Glenarden, Lanham, Hyattsville, Capitol Heights, District Heights,
Suitland, College Park, Seat Pleasant (Maryland) and Washington, DC.
Northern Virginia occasionally. Call to check.
We come to you. There is no walk-in location.

## Hours
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM.
